name: @allfantasy/widget-js
description: AllFantasy Widget SDK — plain JavaScript embed adapter (Phase 7.17/7.18): `AllFantasy.createWidget({ container, config, auth, apiKey, baseUrl })`, the weakest-isolation embed target. Reuses @allfantasy/widget-react internally to render, so a host page never installs React itself — the single entry point bundles React as a real dependency (same strategy as widget-web-component, opposite of widget-react/widget-iframe, per PHASE_7_22_SDK_PACKAGING_ADR.md D6). Consumes only the frozen lib/decision-os/sdk + lib/decision-os/presentation/widget-contracts contracts (PHASE_7_5_WIDGET_RUNTIME_BOUNDARY_ADR.md).
